no_oracle_leakage_confirmed.rule: all online variants use no offline/oracle evidence

hidden_feature_leakage_detected.rule: features used by policy are subset of observed features

shared_positions_used.rule: all variants use the same precomputed episode positions

hard_exclusion_used.rule: hard_exclusion is always false for all variants

deceptive_family_preservation_valid.rule: all deceptive objects preserve expected family identity

selected_probe_set_identical_scale1_scal.rule: all selected probe object-action pairs are identical between scale=1 and scale=3

candidate_pool_exclusion_detected.rule: missed offline-avoidable PVs due to candidate pool exclusion

observation_unavailable_detected.rule: missed offline-avoidable PVs due to observation unavailable

raw_penalty_zero_dominates.rule: raw_penalty_zero explains more missed PVs than any other failure mode

clipping_or_floor_saturation_dominates.rule: clipping_or_floor_saturation explains more missed PVs than any other failure mode

rank_unchanged_dominates.rule: rank_unchanged explains more missed PVs than any other failure mode

top_k_threshold_failure_dominates.rule: top_k_threshold_failure explains more missed PVs than any other failure mode

budget_or_probe_count_limit_dominates.rule: budget_or_probe_count_limit explains more missed PVs than any other failure mode

decision_path_failure_mode_identified.rule: dominant failure mode is identified from missed offline-avoidable PVs

implementation_status.rule: pass if audit completes and no leakage is detected; partial if leakage or missing table
